From the editor

Life moves quickly.
Some stories shouldn't.

Chapter is a place to pause. To follow a curiosity a little further, look at familiar things with fresh eyes, and make room for a story you didn't know you needed.

This first issue begins with a simple thought: perhaps the most interesting route is the one that gives us time to notice. A long walk. An open window. A conversation without a clock.

Thank you for being here. Take your time.
